description: This file defines a command-line command 'tail-log' for tailing the recent transcript lines from a logs store. It utilizes the Commander library for command-line parsing and interacts with the TranscriptsStore singleton to retrieve and display the latest log lines.

classes.name: TailLogCommand
classes.description: A command implementation conforming to ParsableCommand for tailing recent logs.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the latest transcript lines from the shared store and prints the last 10 lines.
